leader_profile.name: JAIMIN PATEL
bio_paragraphs: Over the last 6 years, my focus has been simple: demystifying direct commerce and digital communication for people who want to generate ethical, secondary income streams without risking their life savings.

Having started from college with zero sales background, I experienced firsthand how traditional corporate paths often fail to teach real-world negotiation, digital reach, and leadership. Through disciplined execution and ethical mentorship, I built a community that values transparency above hype.
Today, TEAM JAIMIN is recognized for its structured curriculum, zero-fee entry philosophy, and strict adherence to the Consumer Protection (Direct Selling) Rules of India.
leader_profile.personal_mission: To equip 5,000 ambitious individuals with high-leverage business literacy, transparent direct selling practices, and sustainable financial resilience by 2028.

faqs.question: Is this an employment job or an independent business opportunity?
faqs.answer: This is an independent direct selling business opportunity, not salaried employment. You work as an independent direct distributor. Your earnings depend directly on legitimate product sales volume and your team’s collective sales, governed strictly by the Consumer Protection (Direct Selling) Rules, 2021.

faqs.question: Is this completely legal in India?
faqs.answer: Yes, 100%. Our partner enterprise is registered with the Ministry of Corporate Affairs (MCA), has active GSTIN registration, complies with the Department of Consumer Affairs Direct Selling Guidelines 2021 & 2023 amendment, and all payouts are credited after statutory government TDS deductions with official Form 16A.

faqs.question: Is there any joining fee, kit purchase, or hidden charge?
faqs.answer: No. As per Indian Direct Selling Rules, there is strictly ZERO joining fee, zero registration charge, and zero mandatory starter kit purchase. Anyone with a valid PAN and Aadhaar can register for free.

faqs.question: Can I do this part-time alongside my college or job?
faqs.answer: Yes. 80% of our active team members are students or working professionals who invest 1 to 2 dedicated hours every evening. Our digital workflows, recorded modules, and scheduled weekend masterminds are tailored for flexible execution.

faqs.question: Do I need prior sales experience or technical skills?
faqs.answer: No prior experience is necessary. TEAM JAIMIN provides a 7-day foundation bootcamp covering communication, product orientation, customer handling, and social media etiquette.

faqs.question: How and when do we receive our payouts?
faqs.answer: Earnings are settled weekly on Tuesdays directly into your bank account via NEFT/IMPS. You can view your real-time ledger, retail commissions, and team bonuses inside the official partner distributor portal.

faqs.question: Are there any guaranteed earnings or fixed monthly returns?
faqs.answer: No. We strictly prohibit false guarantees. There are no fixed returns, guaranteed minimum wages, or interest schemes. Your income is directly proportionate to real sales performance, effort, consumer demand, and consistency.

faqs.question: How can I verify the company documents myself?
faqs.answer: You can verify the corporate CIN directly on the Ministry of Corporate Affairs portal (mca.gov.in), verify GST status on services.gst.gov.in, and inspect all certificates in the Company Proof section of this website.

faqs.question: What ongoing support will I receive from Jamin and the team?
faqs.answer: You get direct WhatsApp access to Jamin Patel, daily 8:30 PM skill sessions, weekly doubt resolution calls, pre-designed marketing collaterals, and admission to our community group.
